About the studio

Led from the front, by design.

One studio for interiors, construction and 3D visualisation — because a project should not need three different companies to get built.

The founder

Garvit Maheshwari

APX Studio was founded by Garvit Maheshwari at 26, out of a simple frustration: interiors, construction and 3D visualisation are usually sold as three separate services, run by three people who rarely speak to each other.

Alongside interiors and construction, the studio designs and 3D prints custom miniatures and personalised figurines — a small workshop line that has grown into some of our most requested gifting work. See those pieces →

APX Studio exists to close that gap. One point of contact, one team, one standard — from the first floor plan to the last coat of paint. Garvit is personally involved in every project the studio takes on, from the initial site visit through to final handover.

Garvit Maheshwari Founder & Principal Designer
How we work

Three commitments we hold to.

01

One team, start to finish

The person who designs your kitchen sits on the same team as the person who builds it. Nothing is lost between departments, because there are none.

02

See it before it is built

Renders and walkthroughs come first, so you approve a room you can already picture rather than hoping it turns out.

03

Personally on site

Garvit visits every project himself — the same person from the first sketch to the final walkthrough, not a rotating account manager.

Also from the studio

3D models & miniature statues.

Alongside the interiors work we model and print custom figurines — a couple, a family, a pet, taken from a photograph — plus miniature statues and showpieces for gifting. It grew out of the 3D visualisation side of the studio and has become a practice of its own.
